div.div: ChangeFlow v1.0 | Main success path. Framework details are grouped where doing so improves readability without changing the flow.

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

div.div:
1. Business Analyst starts logged out
2. User enters valid credentials
3. System authenticates and returns a JWT
4. Current user and authorities are loaded
5. User opens New Change Request
6. User completes the request form
7. User chooses Save Draft or Submit
8. System persists and displays the request
